comment:
HMIS and RHIS terminology. We often define RHIS as all routine health-facility-based systems, which includes registers, HR, surveillance, lab and logistics systems. https://iris.who.int/server/api/core/bitstreams/20f53c27-babe-406b-8ffc-09cf96e4c08f/content

HMIS is a subset of RHIS, used for reporting and analytics of aggregate/anonymized routine facility data on health services and outcomes.
